description: Tram - Stations is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Liège. Le jeu de données reprend les géolocalisations des différents arrêts du tram de Liège. Pour en savoir plus sur le projet du tram de Liège: Les modèles 3D sont fournit par Miysis sous licence CC-BY-NC-ND (pas d'utilisation commerciale et pas de modification permise). --. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are tram, mobilité, transport. The portal shows 23 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-11-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
